code_paths.note: Research script kept verbatim in tools/asltunnel.py (plus the xxtea/fieldcrypt/tweakcrypt modules it was built from). Operational adapters: server_catalog_decoder.py (bridge run()) and file_decoder.py (engine CLI).

connection_authentication.note: No HMAC observed in the catalog envelope, the .asl format, or the text-import paths. The envelope uses XXTEA + AES/CFB + AES/CBC with no MAC; .asl uses AES-256-CBC with no MAC. No evidence was found that any HMAC authenticates a VPN connection; no live login or connection was attempted. The absence claim covers only the code paths reviewed. A third-party service token was observed in the app code during the analysis; it was EXCLUDED from this dossier and from every staged file (see ANALYSIS.md).
